I traced the overwrite to [`DeviceConfig._load()`](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts:68). It writes whenever stored JSON exists, even when the version is current and a signup token is present. That write occurs before several fields are restored, so it can replace a complete stored config with a partial one.

Migration also leaves V2 credentials as an array. The loader turns that array into a Map keyed by array indexes, so lookup by user ID fails. The class lacks the required single config object, public static version and storage key, and controlled constructor parameters. Storage read failures and malformed stored values can still interrupt initialization.

I recorded the diagnosis and fix scope in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). The existing test covers only direct V2 credential conversion; it does not test loading or writes. I did not edit source or tests because this run’s assigned role is fault localization only, despite the request to implement the fix.

Updated [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts) to keep persisted fields in one config object. Loading a current config with a signup token now makes no storage write; migration and missing-token generation write only after all fields are restored. V2 credentials migrate to an object keyed by user ID and load into a Map.

Added regression coverage in [DeviceConfigTest.ts](/app/test/client/misc/DeviceConfigTest.ts). Source and test type checks passed, and the client suite passed with 3,071 assertions.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** The patched loader reads only `_themeId`. The previous loader also accepted legacy `_theme`, so migrating a stored config that has only `_theme` resets the selected theme to `light` and writes that value. Copy `_theme` to `_themeId` during migration when `_themeId` is absent. See [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts:118).

An array of `_credentials` with a missing or nonnumeric `_version` is also loaded as an empty Map. Migration should recognize the array shape before rewriting storage. See [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts:106).

**Tests:** `npm run testclient` passed (3,071 assertions); `npm run types` passed. The existing tests do not cover these migration cases. **TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None.

Fixed the DeviceConfig migration cases identified in review. Loading now preserves legacy `_theme` as `_themeId` and converts array `_credentials` even when `_version` is missing or nonnumeric. Added regression tests that also check repeat initialization avoids unnecessary writes.

`npm run types` passed, `npm run testclient` passed (3,093 assertions), and `git diff --check` passed. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
